subject.title: fix(ui): prevent unsafe custodian nudge answers

question: Should the protected Custodian UI change be accepted after a real hosted-wizard proof confirms that sensitive prompts suppress health nudges and closed-question Skip advances correctly?
rationale: The patch changes a sensitive UI-to-wizard answer boundary and the item is explicitly maintainer-labeled; source tests do not replace observed runtime behavior.

options.title: Request runtime proof, then review
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, recording, or screenshots from a real Custodian hosted-wizard interaction before the UI owner completes review.

options.title: Accept test-only evidence
options.body: Proceed on the existing regression and CI evidence while explicitly accepting the remaining runtime-proof uncertainty.

recommendation.title: Request runtime proof, then review
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, recording, or screenshots from a real Custodian hosted-wizard interaction before the UI owner completes review.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history only identifies this person as the recent contributor to the affected Custodian paths; current-main ownership requires a successful history read.
